title: Minecraft Gradient Text Generator | MiniMessage & Legacy Hex
description: Generate Minecraft gradient text for ranks, chat, menus, scoreboards, and server branding. Copy MiniMessage or legacy hex output.
intro: Create smooth Minecraft text gradients for rank prefixes, chat formats, tab lists, scoreboard titles, menu names, and server branding.
howTo: Enter the text you want to style.
Choose a start color and end color.
Copy MiniMessage for modern plugins or legacy hex for configs that use per-character hex codes.
faqs: A gradient gradually blends text from one color into another color.
Where can I use gradient text?
Common places include rank prefixes, chat formats, tab lists, scoreboard titles, menu names, and server branding.
Why does my gradient not work?
Your plugin or Minecraft version may not support the output format you copied. Try another format or check the plugin docs.
